concerns.text: The research question (Research.md) explicitly requires computing lagged Pearson and Spearman correlations **on storm‑filtered data (Dst < ‑50 nT)** to assess relationships during geomagnetic storms. The implementation plan, however, computes correlations on the **full continuous series** (1998‑2020) and only later validates on a held‑out period without any storm filtering. This mismatch means the analysis does not actually test the hypothesis of interest, rendering the validation non‑independent of the intended scientific claim and making the planned study incapable of answering the stated research question.
